prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1474; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the initial loss report for the left-turn collision at the signalized intersection. Insured states the oncoming vehicle approached at speed as they completed the turn. Claimant vehicle sustained front-end and driver-side damage. Photos requested from both parties and scene diagram obtained from the responding officer.

Entry 2: Claimant's attorney submitted a letter of representation today. All further communication to be routed through counsel. Recorded attorney's contact details in the file and noted that the claimant reports a shoulder injury following the impact. Medical authorization forms requested through counsel.

Entry 3: Spoke with defense counsel regarding liability. Preliminary review of the scene diagram and witness statement suggests the insured may have had a duty to yield on the left turn. Signal phase data requested from the municipality to confirm the sequence at impact. Liability position remains under review.

Entry 4: Received medical records from the claimant's treating provider through counsel. Records document a shoulder injury with reduced range of motion and a recommendation for physical therapy. Treatment ongoing. Requested the complete imaging report and billing itemization to evaluate the injury claim against the policy's bodily injury limits.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant's counsel on the status of the demand package. Counsel indicates the demand will be submitted once treatment concludes and final bills are available. Reserve reviewed and maintained pending receipt of the complete medical file. Next review scheduled for the following month.
